text: Patient with type 2 diabetes was started on metformin because HbA1c increased to 8.2%.
The patient has essential hypertension and takes lisinopril 20 mg daily. Blood pressure today is 148/92 mmHg.
Heart failure exacerbation. Furosemide increased. BNP is 1240 pg/mL. Echocardiogram shows reduced left ventricle function.
Community-acquired pneumonia treated with ceftriaxone. Chest x-ray shows infiltrates in the lungs.
Atrial fibrillation on warfarin. INR is 2.4. The patient also has chronic kidney disease with serum creatinine 1.8 mg/dL.
Type 2 diabetes mellitus and hypertension. Atorvastatin and metformin continued. Hemoglobin A1c 7.1%.
